row: Liz Brown | Pelvic & Sports Physical Therapist

About me:
I'm a pelvic floor physiotherapist with 9+ years of experience. I've worked with hundreds of women through pregnancy, birth, postpartum recovery, sport, and menopause. My mission is to make pelvic floor knowledge something every woman has, without the awkwardness, jargon, or shame.
